title: ShopTrueProfit Fee & Profit (batch mode)
description: Standard runs compute one or more calculations and save each result to the dataset. For AI agents, use the MCP endpoint instead (Standby): https://<this-actor-standby-url>/mcp. Each successful calculation is one "fee-calculation" event; list_* tools and rejected inputs are free.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: Which calculation to run. Use "calls" below to run several in one go.

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Arguments for the tool, exactly as the MCP tool takes them. Percent fields are percents (8.25 = 8.25%); money is in USD (or the Etsy region currency). See the README for every field.

calls.title: Batch of calls (optional)
calls.description: Run many calculations in one run: [{"tool": "etsy_profit", "arguments": {...}}, ...]. Up to 1,000 per run. Each result is one dataset item.
